Description: Neither Categories (Agro_econ;Rural_Development;TR_ruralGov;Land_Policy) nor TopicGloss mention Law 6360, even though the article's closing paragraphs contain an explicit, on-the-record statement about it from Diyarbakır Buyuksehir Belediyesi Co-Mayor Firat Anli: "Bugune kadar buyuksehir belediyelerinin tarim ve hayvancilik faaliyetlerine dolayli katildigini ancak son duzenlemeyle 30 buyuksehir belediyesinin artik bu konuda sorumluluk ve gorev alacagini dile getiren Anli..." (i.e. until now metropolitan municipalities only participated in agriculture/livestock activity indirectly, but under the recent regulation 30 metropolitan municipalities will now take on direct responsibility/duty in this area) plus his statement that Diyarbakir Buyuksehir Belediyesi will establish a new 'Yerel Ekonomiyi Destekleme Dairesi Baskanligi' as a result. This is the confirmed miss referenced in the QA brief -- a Metropolitan Law detail buried in a quote near the end of an otherwise unrelated fair-opening article, missed by both the Categories field and the TopicGloss.
SuggestedFix: Add Buyuksehir_Law (Metropolitan_Law) to Categories and revise TopicGloss to mention the Law 6360 / metropolitan-municipality agricultural-responsibility detail from Anli's remarks.

column6: consistent with how similarly thin site-visit content is tagged elsewhere in the corpus.
